snippet.title: Worlds of Ultima: The Savage Empire (PC/DOS) 1990, Origin Systems
snippet.description:
Worlds of Ultima: The Savage Empire is a role-playing video game set in the Ultima series, published in 1990. It is considered a "Worlds of Ultima" game, as it is not set in Britannia. It uses the same engine as Ultima VI (and Martian Dreams)
--
